registrationNote: The official IPL 2027 Released Player List is now published and has been used to reconcile the release status of researched names. The separate official 2027 “To Be Auctioned” page was checked on 21 November 2026 and returned no player rows. A released player is not automatically auction-registered; researched candidates remain provisional until individually matched against the official auction list.
priceModelNote: No calibrated 2027 player-price model or comparable candidate-level price dataset is included. Planned bids are manual scenario assumptions used for purse arithmetic only. No walk-away price is calculated. Historical salary or auction prices are not projected forward.
